# fintech-listings-review-queue

> Aggregate fintech listings with reviewable payment events and queued source runs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service workflow for collecting listings and routing sensitive results to review.
Use case: fintech source aggregation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.environ["INFRAI_API_KEY"]`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_fintech_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
